reader.requirement: At --std 85, ACOS must return the arccosine for every argument-1 in the closed interval [-1, +1] (both endpoints, values a hair inside them, items of any usage, literals and expressions); outside it the result is undefined (A.2.2), and a never-executed out-of-range reference must not stop the program from compiling and running.

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 edition window: IntrinsicSig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 module rows) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel, COBOL1502/COBOL1503
EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION is fatal only under enabled checking (unreachable at 85); default result 0

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|Version in IntrinsicRenderer DomainArg/RenderFloat and CobolIntrinsics.Float.cs (Admits/ClosedUnit): no edition test on the domain or the body
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_acos_domain_accept covers literals 1, -1, 0; values a hair inside the bounds, binary and expression operands and the undefined out-of-range arm are not exercised

probes.printed: START END (compiles and runs; the unexecuted ACOS(2) is not refused)
probes.expected: a reference never evaluated has no value; the program runs

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.5.3 AR2  (2.5.3 Arguments)  the text is in AR2
OK  §1989:A.2.2  (2.2 ARGUMENTS**)  the text is in the clause ('do not have values within the permissible range, then the result of such a reference is undefined')

reader.notes: The ClosedUnit screen decides the domain on the exact scaled operand, so values one unit in the 17th place inside the bounds are admitted and computed accurately, and values just outside are screened rather than rounded onto the bound. Out-of-range values give 0 under unchecked EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION, which 1985 leaves undefined.
